root_idea.summary: The root centers on nearness and being next to something or someone.
root_idea.development: From physical or relational proximity develop the meanings of attachment, alliance, protection, guardianship, authority, succession, and comparative priority.

senses.definition: To be near, next to, or immediately adjacent to.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrence, the verb describes people situated close to those addressed.

senses.definition: To turn, direct, or cause someone or something to face toward a direction.
senses.usage_conditions: The construction may take a direct object, including a person, face, or body, and expresses directed orientation.

senses.definition: To cause someone or something to turn away or back; to turn away, retreat, or be turned back.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic form covers both causative uses and contexts in which a group or person turns away or retreats.

senses.definition: To turn away, withdraw, depart, or turn one's back.
senses.usage_conditions: The turning may be bodily or may consist in refusing to listen, obey, or remain receptive; constructions with عَنْ explicitly express turning away from something.

senses.definition: To attach oneself to someone as an ally, friend, or protective associate.
senses.usage_conditions: The verb expresses assuming an affiliative or protective relationship with its object, especially in constructions translated as taking someone as an ally.

senses.definition: To take charge of or undertake an affair; to assume responsibility or authority.
senses.usage_conditions: The object may be an affair or matter that one undertakes or assumes responsibility for.

senses.definition: Nearer or closer, especially in relationship, attachment, or priority.
senses.usage_conditions: The comparative may describe relational closeness or a stronger claim of proximity; the dual form refers to two persons with the stronger claim or priority.

senses.definition: More worthy, entitled, deserving, fit, or appropriate for something.
senses.usage_conditions: It commonly occurs with بِـ to express having the better or strongest right, claim, suitability, or entitlement; this also supports fortiori constructions.

senses.definition: In the repeated expression أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ, an expression of impending punishment or woe.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic expression is interpreted in the lexical tradition as a threat or warning, with explanations relating it to approaching punishment, rebuke, or the consequence that is most fitting.

senses.definition: A protector, patron, master, or guardian; one who has a protective or governing relationship with another.
senses.usage_conditions: The term is relational and may describe the superior or responsible party in a protective, patronal, or governing bond.

senses.definition: A close relation, ally, or affiliated associate; in plural usage, a successor or heir.
senses.usage_conditions: The relationship may arise from kinship, alliance, or another close affiliation; the Quranic plural forms include contexts of succession and inheritance.

senses.definition: A guardian, protector, manager, or person who has charge of another or of another's affairs.
senses.usage_conditions: The term may describe protective authority over a person, property, or affair, including divine protection and guardianship.

senses.definition: A close ally, friend, or devoted associate; in religious usage, a favored or devoted friend of God.
senses.usage_conditions: The plural أَوْلِيَاءُ is frequently used for allied, protective, or spiritually devoted associates.

senses.definition: A legal guardian, executor, heir, or next of kin with recognized responsibility or claim.
senses.usage_conditions: The sense is used in contexts of guardianship, execution of a deceased person's affairs, inheritance, and the legal standing of a close relative.

senses.definition: One who turns or directs something toward a direction.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic active participle occurs in the construction of turning the face or attention toward a designated direction.

senses.definition: A governor, ruler, or person vested with protective or administrative authority.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic active participle is explained as equivalent to a وَلِيّ in the sense of one exercising charge or protective authority.
This relational noun describes the bond or condition of mutual protection and support.

senses.definition: Authority, guardianship, or taking charge of an affair.
senses.usage_conditions: The lexical tradition distinguishes the authority/administrative sense from the support sense by vocalization, while both belong to the semantic field of being responsible for or close to another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hold command or authority over a thing, country, province, town, or affair; to manage, govern, preside over, or superintend it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the direct verbal construction of exercising charge or authority.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To perform or carry out an act oneself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A construction in which the subject performs the indicated act directly.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To recede or decline, and figuratively to deteriorate or pass into a worse state.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Classically said of such things as war, night, an affair, or a person declining through age; these are extensions of retreat or retrogression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To appoint someone over an affair or set someone to supervise or carry it out.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction expresses conferring administrative charge on a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put someone or something behind oneself or turn one's back on it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This conventional construction may imply leaving something behind, avoiding it, or placing oneself in a position of defense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be next or adjacent to something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of one place or tract in relation to another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make things consecutive, successive, or uninterrupted; to connect them in succession.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction describes continuity or ordered succession between things or affairs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To befriend someone or act as a friend and ally.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the Form III reciprocal or relational construction of friendly association.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give or bring something near.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form IV verb expresses causing something to reach or become near.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To confer a benefit or favor, put someone in possession of something, or bring a condition upon someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object may be a favor or benefit, and the same causative construction can also express bringing abasement or ignominy upon someone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To master or gain control over someone or something; to obtain it in one's possession or power.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction commonly occurs with عَلَى and expresses established control or dominance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The next of kin of a slain person who manages the resulting affair, or the killer's next of kin who is answerable for him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a specialized legal kinship usage distinct from ordinary protection or friendship.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One entitled to praise or possessing praise.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in the specialized expression اللهُ وَلِيُّ الحَمْدِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Rain that follows the وَسْمِيّ rain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare lexical sense based on temporal succession: the later rain is called وَلِيّ because it follows the earlier rain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Relationship, affiliation, or a bond of attachment between persons.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may also denote the people belonging to such an affiliation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The legally recognized right to inherit the property of an emancipated slave.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the technical law-of-clientage sense of الولاء.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A freedman or client, and by extension a slave within the corresponding patronage relationship.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is relational and can designate either side of the emancipation-based bond, depending on context.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A short poetic form, generally of five lines, usually with a repeated rhyme.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a specialized literary term and is unrelated to the ordinary relational noun except in form.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Departure and turning away covered by the Quranic away/back sense.
Avoidance and shunning covered by the away sense.
Retreat while fleeing covered by turning back or retreating.
Turning one's back covered by the same conventional construction.
Retreat or decline of night covered.
Conferring, possession, and bringing a condition represented.
Turning toward or away is resolved in the Quranic away sense here.
Turning the back is covered by withdrawal and departure.
Taking charge of an affair represented.
Undertaking the main part of an affair covered by assuming charge.
An argument overcoming someone is covered by gaining mastery.
Management, guardianship, inheritance, and specialized next-of-kin roles represented.
Devoted or favored friend of God represented.
Saint or devoted friend covered by the religious friend sense.
People of affiliation covered by the relationship sense.
Comparative nearness, entitlement, and worthiness represented.
More worthy or fit is covered by the comparative worthiness sense.
Fortiori construction is covered by the comparative entitlement sense.
Lord or chief is covered by the Quranic patron/master sense.
Kinship and relation are covered by the affiliated-associate sense.
Freedman, client, and slave usage represented separately.

cautions: وِلَايَة and وَلَايَة are reported with a vocalic distinction in the lexical tradition: one is associated especially with support, and the other with taking charge or authority; Quranic translation may render the same relational field as protection, guardianship, alliance, or authority.

وَلِيّ and مَوْلَى are relational terms whose direction of attachment or responsibility is determined by context; they can designate a protector, ally, patron, master, client, relation, or other associated party rather than a single fixed English role.

The repeated Quranic expression أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ has multiple closely related traditional explanations involving threat, approaching punishment, or rebuke; it is therefore kept as a distinct expression rather than reduced to ordinary comparative worthiness.
